set -u
NS=fwbench8080
P1=
P2=
cleanup() {
  [ -n "$P1" ] && kill "$P1" 2>/dev/null || true
  [ -n "$P2" ] && kill "$P2" 2>/dev/null || true

  sudo -n /sbin/ip link del fw-host 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT
sudo -n /sbin/ip netns add "$NS"
sudo -n /sbin/ip link add fw-host type veth peer name fw-peer
sudo -n /sbin/ip link set fw-peer netns "$NS"
sudo -n /sbin/ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev fw-host
sudo -n /sbin/ip link set fw-host up
sudo -n /sbin/ip netns exec "$NS" /sbin/ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev fw-peer
sudo -n /sbin/ip netns exec "$NS" /sbin/ip link set lo up
sudo -n /sbin/ip netns exec "$NS" /sbin/ip link set fw-peer up
cd /tmp
python -m SimpleHTTPServer 8080 >/tmp/fw-8080-test.log 2>&1 & P1=$!
python -m SimpleHTTPServer 8081 >/tmp/fw-8081-test.log 2>&1 & P2=$!
sleep 1
printf '%s\n' '=== both test services are listening ==='
netstat -lnt 2>/dev/null | egrep '(:8080 |:8081 )'
printf '%s\n' '=== counters before ==='
sudo -n /sbin/iptables -vnL IN_public_allow
sudo -n /sbin/iptables -vnL INPUT
printf '%s\n' '=== allowed 8080 test from isolated source namespace ==='
if sudo -n /sbin/ip netns exec "$NS" curl --max-time 3 -sS http://192.0.2.1:8080/ -o /dev/null; then
  printf '%s\n' 'PASS: TCP/8080 reached the listening service'
else
  printf '%s\n' 'FAIL: TCP/8080 was not reachable'
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' '=== unrelated 8081 test from isolated source namespace ==='

  sed -n '1,3p' /tmp/fw-8081-curl.err
fi
printf '%s\n' '=== counters after ==='
sudo -n /sbin/iptables -vnL IN_public_allow
sudo -n /sbin/iptables -vnL INPUT
ANTRIEB_FW_TEST

  sudo -n /sbin/ip netns del "$NS" 2>/dev/null || true
  sudo -n /sbin/ip link del fw-post 2>/dev/null || true
}
